followups.summary: The College of Policing confirmed that the updated First Aid Learning Programme (FALP) will be implemented by the end of April 2025, incorporating recommendations from the Manchester Arena Inquiry and updated guidance from the UK Resuscitation Council.

sources.title: Updated first aid training for officers | College of Policing
sources.quote: The updated first aid learning programme (FALP) will mean that officers now receive at least 12 hours of first aid training and a refresher course each year. Using the NHS's 10-second triage will bring policing into line with other emergency services. Alongside these additions, the curriculum still includes training on dealing with stab wounds, acid attacks and giving cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR).

sources.title: Police first aid training significantly bolstered to save lives
sources.quote: Learning and recommendations following the Manchester Arena Inquiry are in the new First Aid Learning Programme. This includes the management of catastrophic bleeding and the ability to assess the seriousness of a person's injuries within 10 seconds so the officer can help those most seriously ill first. Using the NHS's ten second triage will bring policing into line with other emergency services.
